title: AB 941 (2025-2026 Wisconsin Legislature, regular session): student identification used for voting.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) s. 5.02 (6m) (f) as amended (student ID cards)
(quote) 5.02 (6m) (f) An identification card issued by a university or college in this state that is accredited, as defined in s. 39.30 (1) (d), or by a technical college in this state that is a member of and governed by the technical college system under ch. 38, that contains the date of issuance and signature of the individual to whom it is issued and that contains an expiration date indicating that the card expires no later than 2 years after the date of issuance, except that, if the identification card is expired, the individual shall establish that he or she is enrolled as a student at the university or college on the date that the card is presented.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) LRB analysis (printed with the bill): This bill allows a student to use an expired student identification card under certain circumstances.
(other) LRB analysis (printed with the bill): Under the bill, a student does not need to present proof of enrollment if using an unexpired identification card but must provide proof of enrollment if using an expired identification card.
